notes.title: Guild & Gals demo release!
notes.notes:
Guild & Gals demo released!


Guild & Gals, our upcoming managerial harem game for adults demo is now available on  Steam!!  



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1653230/Guild__Gals/"][/dynamiclink]  




Demo contains first 5 missions and over 10 playable characters!!


Guild & Gals is a game where you manage a huge roster of mercenaries, undertaking dangerous missions with adaptive AI for your mercenaries with huge boobs!  Numerous mercenaries to recruit, each with their own unique personalities!   Shower your mercenaries with gifts and raise your relationships to build friendships or even deeper relationships!   


Wishlist the game today!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1653230/Guild__Gals/"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: FULL RELEASE! Version 1.0

Uncommon armors now drop with each Earth Monster

Compressed some of the audio to help improve load times
Audio is now set to 40% when starting the game first time

Basic attacks by Ice Titan have chance of causing freezing 
Final boss now deals darkness damage
Final boss can now unleash the attacks made against their final form
Erotic Manusaurus no longer waits
Erotic Manusaurus can perform Money Shots better
Erotic Manusaurus can now seduce you

Bad Mr. Frosty base hp is now 20000 (was 15500)
Bad Mr. Frosty base attack is now 85 (was 70)
Bad Mr. Frosty base defense is now 36 (was 30)
Bad Mr. Frosty now enjoys same sort of 30% barrier that his hat would grant player

You need to be level 8 to learn Summon Ignis

Cain Attack is 50 (was 40)
Cain Wisdom is 55 (was 45)

Completely overhauled battle system 

Blackjack

You can now play Blackjack at the Casino

Boulderscar

Added random houses for immersion

Bugfix

Friendship sending you to wrong location on spawn has been fixed

Passability problem in Dudecave has been fixed
Passability problem in Jessica's Castle has been fixed
You could use "Staff Speciality" even though it was a passive, this has been fixed

Meditation didn't give you TP, this has been fixed

Improved cache for less memory usage

Description

Added better description that turning Behemoth increases all stats including Wisdom of Rosa

Dragonbones

Dragonbones integrated monsters

Export Character

If you beat the game and receive a good ending, you'll be asked if you want to export the save data. This will be used to transfer important choices that you've made in this game, to be read in a potential sequel.

Gameplay

Completely redesigned the way battles work
Reworked accuracy for less misses
Leveling up now heals you and restores your mana
You'll always succeed at escaping
